requests.prompt: Edit the supplied animation sheet for our personal Patrick Star watch companion. Patrick wears a cheerful yellow hooded raincoat open at the face with purple shorts visible and pink feet, holding a small blue umbrella. Keep the character body proportions, face size, foot baseline, camera, costume and umbrella consistent throughout. Movement is in the arm, eyes, mouth and brows, not rigid rocking or changing scale. Leave generous space around every whole character and umbrella, genuine transparent background, no scenery or puddle, no captions, cell lines, numbers, shadows, cropped heads or feet. All eight characters at the same scale.

requests.prompt: Create a replacement running animation sheet for Patrick Star in the reference's flat 2D cartoon style and purple/white sweatband, purple wristbands and green flower shorts. Fix the reference's abrupt left-right facing changes: every pose must face straight toward the viewer, camera and head orientation remain fixed, both eyes look forward. Twelve separate drawings in FOUR columns and THREE rows, genuine alpha transparency. 1 relaxed standing; 2 slight knee bend and elbows prepare; 3 left knee begins rising and opposite arm begins swinging; 4 left knee raised; 5 left foot descends through the center, arms passing; 6 both feet approach support, elbows midway; 7 right knee starts rising, opposite arm swings; 8 right knee raised; 9 right foot descends through center, arms passing; 10 both feet return to ground, arms easing down; 11 shoulders relax, coral eyelids half-close; 12 same relaxed pose and eye expression as drawing1. Connected shoulder/arm and leg anatomy, real redrawn action rather than rigid whole-body sway. Keep face width, eye spacing, torso mass and camera distance consistent in all12; natural small knee/body movement is okay, do not resize bodies to fit cells. White sclera, black pupils, coral pink skin and eyelids. Each full character occupies at most70percent cell height with ample transparent space around head, hands and feet. No breath cloud, scenery, text, labels, grids or shadows. Keep chronological motion smooth; no alternating side-facing views, no changing head size, no missing or extra limbs.

Edit this eight-frame Patrick Star raincoat animation sheet for better readability on a small watch screen. Hold a smaller short-handled umbrella just above the head; do not let the umbrella make the character tiny. The umbrella canopy may be no wider than his seated body, with minimal empty distance above his head. Maintain identical face size and seated torso/feet construction through all eight poses. Arrange FOUR columns and TWO rows on true transparent alpha, generous space between full silhouettes. Redraw a smooth action in reading order: 1 relaxed seated holding umbrella with left hand; 2 only eyes glance upward; 3 right arm starts raising; 4 right palm reaches outward; 5 right elbow lowers halfway; 6 brief closed-eye deadpan shrug with coral eyelids; 7 right hand settles onto knee and eyes begin opening; 8 same seated relaxed face and hand position as1. The left hand continuously grips the same umbrella handle. Preserve natural arm and clothing connections. No rigid body rocking, scaling, tiny final poses, background, shadows, captions or cell borders. Both full head and both feet remain entirely visible in every cell.

A new eight-frame outfit animation sheet of Patrick Star as an absent-minded weekend explorer for a personal watch companion. He stands upright wearing a soft mint bucket hat, open pale blue travel vest with two pockets, familiar green and purple flower shorts, and a small orange backpack with visible straps. Pink bare feet, coral skin, white sclera, black pupils; clean flat 2D animated-cartoon lines and colors. His left hand holds a small folded cream paper map. FOUR columns by TWO rows in reading order:1 looks at the map with a serious face;2 tilts eyes upward thinking;3 right hand starts toward his chin;4 right hand touches his chin thoughtfully;5 raises one eyebrow as he has an idea;6 right hand lifts one rounded fingertip to point ahead;7 hand comes back toward his side;8 returns to the first map-reading posture. Real newly drawn connected arm and expression poses, consistent stance, face size, body mass, camera and feet baseline throughout, no whole-body rocking. Keep hat, vest, backpack, map and proportions unchanged. Every full figure has generous clear margins and is completely isolated on genuinely transparent alpha. No ground, landscape, captions, letters on map, labels, grid borders, shadows or clipped hat or feet. Friendly and slightly puzzled, not gross, realistic or overly babyish.
